repairs.tone: Convicts the thing of mileage rather than damage - it has been taken up so many times that nothing in it can still surprise - a lighter charge than the ruin *threadbare* finds or the grubbiness *shopworn* sees.
repairs.reasoning: Rewritten so the overuse is itself the fault, with well-worn made mild by how far the damage has gone rather than by treating the wear as a virtue, and left in the position *threadbare* and *shopworn* already assign it.

repairs.tone: Takes the trouble as agitation rather than dread - a settled mind stirred out of its even running - which makes it a lighter and more momentary thing than the unsettling *disturbing* keeps up.
repairs.reasoning: Drops the formal claim, which *distressful* already holds in this family, and separates perturbing by what its disturbance is - a mind stirred off balance for the moment, not dread and not the sustained unsettling the family gives *disturbing*.
